title: Domino Line
taglineZh: 排成一线，堵住对手，收下牌局。

lines.en: Twenty-eight tiles. One line. First to a hundred.
lines.zh: 二十八张骨牌，一条牌线，先到一百分。

lines.en: Domino Line — block dominoes for the whole table.
lines.zh: 多米诺——适合全家人的堵桌骨牌。

lines.en: Match a pip, draw when stuck, and empty your hand.
lines.zh: 接点数，没牌就摸，先出完手牌。

lines.en: Two to four players, on one screen or a phone across the Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 二到四人，一台设备，或者同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from a gentle Companion to a Hard that samples unseen tiles.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到会采样未见牌的挑战。

lines.en: Hints explain the move. Undo and autosave keep the table friendly.
lines.zh: 提示会说明理由；悔棋和自动保存让牌桌更轻松。

lines.en: The winner starts the next round; a blocked table goes to the fewest pips.
lines.zh: 本局赢家开下一局；牌桌堵死时点数最少者胜。

lines.en: Domino Line. Line up. Block out. Domino.
lines.zh: 多米诺。排成一线，堵住对手。
